description: This PHP source file defines the EndpointDefinitionProvider class within the Aws\EndpointV2 namespace. It provides methods for retrieving endpoint rulesets, tests, and partition data related to AWS service endpoint resolution, handling data fetching from local directories and JSON files.

classes.name: EndpointDefinitionProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for retrieving endpoint-related configuration data, including rulesets, tests, and partition information for AWS services.

methods.name: getEndpointRuleset
methods.description: Returns the ruleset data for a specified service and API version.

methods.name: getEndpointTests
methods.description: Returns the test data for a specified service and API version.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns information about AWS partitions, either from a PHP file or JSON data.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves specific endpoint data or tests based on parameters, reading from files or throwing exceptions if data is missing.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest version of a service from the manifest.
